title: a shorthand body runs after the default and the supplied value
purpose: Order is: defaults, shorthand bindings, then the body.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision, 19.10.2026 (D-035, refined): before the constructor runs, every defaulted field is filled with its default; the constructor then binds the supplied values, replacing defaults; finally every field must be bound, otherwise construction fails. The default runs first, the shorthand binding replaces it with 4, and the body then sees 4.
